mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.15% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as observed in historical low-rate environments.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.15%.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in unemployment rate below 5.0% signals labor market tightening, increasing corporate profit margins and driving positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE falls below 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous housing starts above 1050 thousand and GDP growth exceeding 0.5% quarterly indicate robust consumer demand, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when both HOUST > 1050 and GDPC1 growth rate > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Inflation exceeding 5.0% year-over-year triggers Federal Reserve rate hikes, increasing discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 5.0% y/y.

mechanism_narrative: Rising employment levels (PAYEMS) indicate strong economic activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS rises.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 105.0 indicates manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate output and generating negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO falls below 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales exceeding 440,000 million dollars and housing starts above 1050 thousand signal strong consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when RSAFS > 440000 and HOUST > 1050.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 2.0% y/y) and low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) maintain monetary accommodation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL < 2.0% y/y and FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.
